History of Clashes: A Balanced Rivalry The historical record between Flamengo and Juventude reveals a closely contested rivalry.
Overall Record: 11 wins for each side, with 7 draws in 29 clashes. Last Season: Juventude secured a 2-1 victory at Alfredo Jaconi Stadium, while Flamengo triumphed 4-2 at Maracanã. Recent Form: Flamengo holds a recent advantage with 3 wins,1 draw,and only 1 defeat in the last 5 encounters. Home Dominance: Flamengo boasts 5 straight wins as principal, scoring 18 goals and conceding only 4. Flamengo’s Quest to End Home Drought Flamengo is determined to break their recent home slump and maintain their position at the top of the league.
Recent Victory: Flamengo beat grêmio 2 × 0 away from home in the last round of the Brazilian Championship with two goals from the Arrascaeta midfielder. Recovery: The team rebounded from a 2-1 defeat to Central Cordoba in the Copa Libertadores, their only setback in the last 18 games, during which they secured 14 wins and 3 draws. Brasileirão Performance: Flamengo also defeated Vitória 2-1 away and drew with Internacional 1-1 at Maracanã. Home Form: Flamengo aims to end a three-game winless streak at home, marked by two draws and a defeat. League Standing: As the league leader, Flamengo has 7 points, with two wins and a draw, scoring 5 goals and conceding only 2. Recent Outcomes Central Cordoba de Santiago 2 – Flamengo X

Flamengo vs. Juventude: Predictions, Analysis, and How to Watch by Sports Desk
April 16, 2025
Match Preview: A Clash at Maracanã Rio de Janeiro – Flamengo is set to host Juventude in a highly anticipated match in the Brazilian Championship. The game promises excitement, with Flamengo looking to maintain their strong home form and Juventude aiming to upset the odds. Kickoff is scheduled for 9:30 p.m. Brasília time at the iconic Maracanã Stadium.
Team Overviews Flamengo: Red-Hot Favorites Flamengo enters the match as the clear favorite, boasting an impressive record of 14 wins in their last 18 games. Their attacking prowess and solid defense make them a formidable opponent at home.
Juventude: Seeking an Upset Juventude, while surprising with a good start to the Brasileirão, faces a tough challenge on the road. The team currently sits in fourth place with 6 points,having secured two wins and suffered one defeat.They have scored 4 goals and conceded 3.However, they need to improve their away form if they want to stay at the top of the table.
The team comes from a turning victory over Ceará by 2 × 1 at home , demonstrating their ability to fight back. Prior to that, they lost to botafogo 2 × 0 away from home and debuted with a 2-0 win over Vitória 2 × 0 at home.
However, as a visitor, the team of Caxias do Sul is experiencing a delicate moment, with three straight losses, including the elimination in the first phase of the Brazilian Cup to Maringá, after 1 × 0 loss.
Key Statistics Several statistics point to an exciting match:
Flamengo has seen both teams score in 5 of their last 8 games. Juventude’s matches have featured over 2.5 goals in 4 of their last 7 outings. Flamengo averages 7.00 corners at home, while Juventude averages 5 corners as a visitor this season. Juventude is currently on a three-game losing streak away from home. Predictions and Betting Tips Given flamengo’s strong form and Juventude’s struggles on the road, analysts are leaning towards a Flamengo victory. However, the potential for goals at both ends makes for an intriguing betting landscape.
Betting Tip 1: Both Teams to Score – No Considering Juventude’s recent struggles to score away from home, a solid bet is that both teams will not score in the match. The best odd for this is 1.58 at Superbet.
Betting Tip 2: Flamengo to Win at Halftime Flamengo’s dominance and Juventude’s away form suggest that Flamengo could lead at halftime. The odds for this are @1.59 at Superbet.
Betting Tip 3: Arrascaeta to Score Anytime Arrascaeta is in excellent form, with 3 goals in his last 3 matches. Betting on him to score anytime during the match is a worthwhile consideration, with odds at @2.25 at Br4Bet.
